NeoSkriptWebEffReqnRequest.name: Send Web Request (Reqn)
description: Sends an HTTP request and waits for the answer without blocking the server, as Reqn's did. The method is GET unless given; headers are written Name: value, and several body texts are joined with line breaks.
The trigger carries on when the answer arrives, or with a runtime error if it fails or takes longer than timeout-seconds in NeoSkriptWeb's config.yml. Read it with last response.
examples: send a "POST" request to "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/..." with header "Content-Type: application/json" and body "{""content"": ""Hello""}"

send request to "https://api.example.com/status"
send "%body of last response%" to console

NeoSkriptWebExprReqnLastResponse.name: Last Web Response (Reqn)
description: The answer to the last request this trigger sent with Reqn's syntax, or, if it hasn't sent one, the last one any trigger got. None after a request that failed.

NeoSkriptWebExprReqnUrlEncode.name: URL Encoded Text
description: Text made safe to put in a URL's query: spaces as +, other characters as %XX.

NeoSkriptWebExprReqnJsonEncode.name: JSON Encoded Text
description: Text made safe to put between quotes in JSON: quotes, backslashes and control characters escaped.

NeoSkriptWebExprBody.name: Body
description: The body of a Reqn response (text, each line ending in a line break, as Reqn read it), of an skJson response (JSON if it parses, else text), or of an skJson request.
A request's body can be set to JSON or text, and reset.
examples: send body of last response to console
set body of {_request} to parse "{""name"": ""Steve""}" as json

NeoSkriptWebExprStatusCode.name: Status Code
description: A response's status code: 200, 404 and so on.
examples: if status code of last response is 200:

NeoSkriptWebExprHeaders.name: Headers
description: A Reqn response's headers, each Name: value; an skJson response's or request's headers as JSON.
A request's headers can be set, to Name: value texts or JSON, and reset.
examples: send headers of last response to console

NeoSkriptWebExprStatus.name: Status
description: A Reqn response's status line (HTTP/1.1 200 OK), or an skJson response's status: OK for a status code below 500, FAILED, or UNKNOWN if it got nothing.

NeoSkriptWebExprReqnHeaderKeys.name: Header Keys (Reqn)
description: The names of a Reqn response's headers.
examples: send header keys of last response to console

NeoSkriptWebExprReqnHeaderValues.name: Header Values (Reqn)
description: The values of a Reqn response's headers.
examples: send header values of last response to console

NeoSkriptWebExprReqnMessage.name: Status Message (Reqn)
description: A Reqn response's reason phrase: OK, Not Found.
examples: send status message of last response to console

NeoSkriptWebExprReqnHeader.name: Header Value (Reqn)
description: One header's value from a Reqn response, whatever the case of its name.
examples: set {_type} to "Content-Type" header of last response

NeoSkriptWebExprSkJsonRequest.name: Prepare Request (skJson)
description: A request to configure and then send with execute. Methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, and MOCK, which answers at once without the network. An address without http:// gets it.
examples: set {_request} to prepare POST request on "https://api.example.com/items"

NeoSkriptWebEffSkJsonExecute.name: Execute Request (skJson)
description: Sends a prepared request. By default the trigger waits for the answer without blocking the server, then last response of {_request} has it.
as non blocking carries straight on, and on received http response runs when it's answered.
examples:
execute {_request}
send body of last response of {_request} to console

NeoSkriptWebExprSkJsonLastResponse.name: Last Response of a Request (skJson)
description: What a request got when it was answered. Before that, and after it fails, a response with no status code and the status UNKNOWN.

NeoSkriptWebExprSkJsonQueryParams.name: Query Parameters (skJson)
description: A request's query parameters, as JSON. Set and add them as key:value texts (several in one, split by commas); reset them.

NeoSkriptWebExprSkJsonFromUrl.name: JSON from a URL (skJson)
description: The JSON a GET request to a URL answers with, waited for without blocking the server (skJson blocked it). None for a status code above 400.

NeoSkriptWebExprSkJsonNew.name: New JSON (skJson)
description: JSON from text (read leniently, as skJson does; text that isn't JSON is a JSON string), a number, a boolean or other JSON.

NeoSkriptWebEffSkJsonMap.name: Map JSON to a List Variable (skJson)
description: Puts JSON into a list variable: an object's keys and a list's positions (from 1) are indices, nested ones make lists under them, and null is left out. Other indices already in the list stay.

NeoSkriptWebExprSkJsonFormatted.name: List Variable as JSON (skJson)
description: A list variable, nested lists included, as JSON: its indices are keys, and a nested list whose indices are all numbers is a JSON list, its texts read as JSON where they parse.

NeoSkriptWebExprSkJsonPretty.name: Printed JSON (skJson)
description: JSON as text: indented and coloured for chat (as pretty printed), indented (as uncolored pretty printed, as formatted json), or on one line (as compact json, as minified json).
examples: send {_json} as pretty printed to player

NeoSkriptWebExprSkJsonSize.name: JSON Size (skJson)
description: How many keys a JSON object has, or items a JSON list has.
examples: send json size of {_json} to console

NeoSkriptWebExprSkJsonKeys.name: JSON Keys (skJson)
description: A JSON object's keys, or those of the object at a path.

NeoSkriptWebExprSkJsonValues.name: JSON Values (skJson)
description: The value at a path in JSON (home.x, items[0], lists counted from 0), or every value of an object or list. Objects and lists stay JSON; the rest are text, numbers and booleans.
examples: set {_x} to value at path "home.x" in {_json}

NeoSkriptWebCondSkJsonType.name: JSON Type (skJson)
description: Whether JSON is an object, a list, a value, or null.

NeoSkriptWebCondSkJsonEmpty.name: JSON Is Empty (skJson)
description: Whether JSON is an empty object or list.

NeoSkriptWebCondSkJsonHas.name: JSON Has (skJson)
description: Whether a JSON object has every key given, or JSON has every value given.

NeoSkriptWebEvtSkJsonResponse.name: Received HTTP Response (skJson)
description: A request sent with execute ... as non blocking was answered, or failed. event-response is what it got.
examples:
on received http response:
	send status code of event-response to console

httpresponse.name: HTTP Response (Reqn)
description: An answer to Reqn's send request: its status, headers and body.

request.name: Request (skJson)
description: A request prepared with skJson's syntax, to send with execute.
examples: set {_request} to prepare GET request on "https://example.com"

response.name: Response (skJson)
description: What an skJson request got: its status code, status, headers and body.

requestmethod.name: Request Method (skJson)
description: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, or MOCK.

jsonelement.name: JSON (skJson)
description: JSON: an object, a list, a value or null. Saved in variables as skJson saved it.
